research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Verastem Oncology is researching therapeutic compositions and combination therapies targeting RAS/MAPK pathway-driven cancers. Their work includes methods using FAK inhibitors with immunotherapeutic agents, KRAS G12D inhibitors with dual RAF/MEK inhibitors, and combinations involving DDR pathway, autophagy pathway, and pan-RAF inhibitors. They also explore oral dosage forms of SHP2, SOS1, ERK1/2, CDK4/6, AKT, mTOR, pan-HER, and EGFR inhibitors with MEK or dual RAF/MEK inhibitors, as well as strategies to reduce toxicity.

overview_description.description: Verastem Oncology is a late-stage development biopharmaceutical company committed to the development and commercialization of new medicines to improve the lives of patients diagnosed with RAS/MAPK pathway-driven cancers. Our pipeline is focused on novel small molecule drugs that inhibit critical signaling pathways in cancer that promote cancer cell survival and tumor growth, including RAF/MEK inhibition, FAK inhibition, and KRAS G12D inhibition.

about_short_description.short_description: Verastem is a biopharmaceutical company developing new medicines to improve the lives of patients with RAS/MAPK pathway-driven cancers.

product.name: AVMAPKI FAKZYNJA CO-PACK™
product.description: An FDA-approved oral combination of avutometinib and defactinib for adults with KRAS-mutated recurrent low-grade serous ovarian cancer.

product.name: Avutometinib (VS-6766)
product.description: An oral RAF/MEK clamp designed to inhibit RAS/MAPK signaling and being developed for RAS/MAPK pathway-driven cancers, including ovarian, lung, pancreatic, and other solid tumors.

product.name: Defactinib (VS-6063)
product.description: An oral focal adhesion kinase (FAK) inhibitor developed for combination treatment of RAS/MAPK pathway-driven cancers, including recurrent low-grade serous ovarian cancer.

product.name: VS-7375 (GFH375)
product.description: An oral, selective KRAS G12D ON/OFF inhibitor in Phase 1/2a development for advanced solid tumors with KRAS G12D mutations.

product.name: Verastem-Sponsored Clinical Trials
product.description: Clinical development programs evaluating Verastem medicines and combinations in RAS/MAPK pathway-driven cancers, including ovarian, lung, pancreatic, and other solid tumors.

product.name: Verastem Cares™
product.description: A patient and healthcare-provider support program for people prescribed AVMAPKI FAKZYNJA CO-PACK™, including insurance navigation, financial assistance, and treatment-access logistics.
